text: In 1645, as the English Civil War breaks down order, the witch hunter Matthew Hopkins and his assistant Stearne [tour East Anglia torturing confessions from villagers|threat|the powerful and their systems] and billing the magistrates. In Brandeston they seize the priest John Lowes, and his niece Sara offers herself to save him before Stearne [rapes her|wrong|sexual violation]. Her lover, the young Roundhead soldier Richard Marshall, [vows to kill both men|wants|revenge for a wrong] and follows them to Lavenham, where a trap and [a castle dungeon|images|ropes, cages and executions] are waiting.
